findings.why: every request prefills its whole prompt, including the conversation it shares with the turn before

findings.what: 6.73 GiB of weights a rank live in the pinned host pool and cross PCIe when they are used
findings.why: a prefill step streams every routed layer's pooled experts onto the card, so its speed is bounded by the link; decode reads the ones it routes to
findings.fix: more VRAM for the experts: a shorter --max-model-len or fewer --max-num-seqs, --embedding-placement ram, --kv-cache-dtype fp8, or more cards (--tp)

findings.what: card 0000:0a:00.0 (rank 0): the card's link is 32.0 GT/s x16 at most, and 0000:00:03.1 above it is 16.0 GT/s x8 at most
findings.why: the host side of the link bounds what the card can move to and from host memory: streamed experts, the host pool and the all-reduce when it goes through host memory
findings.fix: a slot with the card's full width and speed (the board manual says which slots share lanes), or no riser; nothing to do if the board has no faster slot

findings.what: card 0000:0d:00.0 (rank 1): the card's link is 32.0 GT/s x16 at most, and 0000:00:03.2 above it is 16.0 GT/s x8 at most
findings.why: the host side of the link bounds what the card can move to and from host memory: streamed experts, the host pool and the all-reduce when it goes through host memory
findings.fix: a slot with the card's full width and speed (the board manual says which slots share lanes), or no riser; nothing to do if the board has no faster slot

findings.what: RLIMIT_MEMLOCK is 8.00 MiB and the n-gram table is read from the container on disk
findings.why: a locked copy of the table in RAM is one of the faster tiers, and the memlock limit is one of the things that keeps --ngram-placement auto off it
findings.fix: Docker: ulimits memlock -1 (--ulimit memlock=-1); systemd: LimitMEMLOCK=infinity

findings.what: the CPU governor is powersave with energy preference balance_performance
findings.why: the host side of a step -- scheduling, sampling, the n-gram gather, launch bookkeeping -- is single-threaded per rank, and a core that ramps slowly shows as host gap between steps
findings.fix: cpupower frequency-set -g performance, or echo performance | sudo tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/energy_performance_preference
